From March 15, Cecilia Vega's report on ships stranded by the Strait of Hormuz closure. Also from March 15, Lesley Stahl's story on how lasers might help fend off Iran's cheap drones. From March 29, Holly Williams' look at the drone arms race transforming modern warfare. From April 19, Vega's report on what it would take for the U.S. to secure Iran's highly enriched uranium. snippet.title: Soldier charged with using classified intel to place bets
snippet.description:
Last month, U.S. Army soldier Gannon Ken Van Dyke was charged with using classified intelligence to place bets on the timing of the capture of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, netting more than $400,000, according to the Justice Department.

According to the indictment, Van Dyke immediately withdrew his profit and then tried to delete his betting account on Polymarket, the world’s largest online prediction market. He has pleaded not guilty. 

Polymarket says it cooperated with law enforcement.
#betting #usnews #insidertrading #predictionmarket

snippet.title: Research finds telltale signs of insider trading on Polymarket #shorts
snippet.description: The Anti-Corruption Data Collective found long-shot wagers — bets of more than $2,500 with less than 35% odds — on military outcomes won more than they lost. Researchers say it’s a telltale sign of “systemic insider-trading.” #insidertrading #predictionmarkets #usnews #betting
